title: Machine-Learning Molecular Dynamics Reveals Grotthuss Transport in Concentrated Electrolytes
title_zh: 机器学习分子动力学揭示了浓电解质中的 Grotthuss 输运
summary: 质子转移是酸性或碱性水溶液中异常高电导率的原因。然而，质子转移机制对浓水溶液电导率的贡献尚不清楚。在这项工作中，我们使用分子动力学模拟和机器学习原子间势 (MLIP)（包括质子转移）来计算不同浓度的 KOH(aq) 系统的输运特性。我们量化了质子转移机制对氢氧根离子和水分子扩散性以及电解质的离子电导率和传输数的贡献。在较低浓度下，贡献很大，但在浓度非常高时，贡献会减弱。
abstract: arXiv:2611.04558v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Proton transfer is responsible for the anomalous high conductivity in acidic or basic aqueous solutions. Yet, the contribution of the proton transfer mechanism to the conductivity of concentrated aqueous solutions is unknown. In this work, we compute the transport properties of KOH(aq) systems with different concentrations, using Molecular Dynamics simulations with a Machine Learning Interatomic Potential (MLIP), which includes proton transfer. We quantify the contribution of the proton transfer mechanism to the diffusivities of hydroxide ions and water molecules, and the ionic conductivity and transport numbers of the electrolytes. The contribution is substantial at lower concentrations, but diminishes at very high concentrations.

title: Excited-state intramolecular proton transfer dynamics with neural network potentials and nuclear quantum effects
title_zh: 具有神经网络势和核量子效应的激发态分子内质子转移动力学
summary: 激发态分子内质子转移是一种典型的超快过程，它构成了许多化学和生物现象的基础，并且对潜在势能景观的变化高度敏感。在这里，我们开发了 10-羟基苯并[h]喹啉的神经网络势，以接近从头计算的精度描述基态和激发态动力学。这些神经网络势能够对质子转移坐标进行有效采样，并通过路径积分分子动力学合并核量子效应。自由能分布表明，激发态分子内质子转移在基本上无势垒的激发态表面上进行，核量子效应减少并平滑了残余势垒。
abstract: Excited-state intramolecular proton transfer is a prototypical ultrafast process that forms the foundation for many chemical and biological phenomena and is highly sensitive to changes in the underlying potential energy landscape. Here, we develop neural network potentials for 10-hydroxybenzo[h]quinoline that describe ground- and excited-state dynamics with near ab initio accuracy. These neural network potentials enable efficient sampling of the proton transfer coordinate and incorporation of nuclear quantum effects through path-integral molecular dynamics. The free energy profiles show that excited-state intramolecular proton transfer proceeds on a largely barrierless excited-state surface, with nuclear quantum effects reducing and smoothing the residual barrier. Non-equilibrium simulations yield an average proton transfer time of ∼11.5 fs for quantum hydrogen, consistent with experiment, and reveal a clear isotope effect, with slower dynamics for deuterium and classical nuclei. Mechanistic analysis identifies transient proton donor–acceptor contraction as the key enabling coordinate, while the proton crosses the midpoint prior to reaching the minimum of this coordinate, indicating a dynamically driven transfer. Subtle changes in the conjugated backbone precede proton transfer, reflecting early electronic reorganization and coherent coupling between proton motion and backbone vibrations. Bond-length alternation and vibrational coherence analysis reveal isotope-dependent coherence loss, with deuteration producing stronger damping and more localized proton/backbone dynamics relative to hydrogen. These results establish neural network potential-based approaches as an effective framework for simulating excited-state proton transfer with explicit nuclear quantum effects.
journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

title: Evidence for a Dirac Spin Liquid in the Kagome Heisenberg Antiferromagnet from High-Precision Neural-Network Quantum States
title_zh: 来自高精度神经网络量子态的 Kagome 海森堡反铁磁体中狄拉克自旋液体的证据
summary: 自旋 1/2 kagome 海森堡反铁磁体是量子自旋液体研究的核心模型，但其基态特性仍未得到解决。我们使用神经网络量子态 (NQS) 和 kagome 几何感知消息传递卷积在包含多达 300 个自旋的二维 tori 上执行大规模变分蒙特卡洛计算，并为 kagome 模型实现极低的变分能量。自旋和二聚体结构因子没有显示出磁性或价键长程有序的证据。此外，主要的对称解析自旋和二聚体相关性表现出与狄拉克自旋液体的新兴 SO(6) 单极多重态一致的常见缩放行为。
abstract: arXiv:2611.05174v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The spin-1/2 kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet is a central model in the study of quantum spin liquids, yet its ground-state properties remain unresolved. We perform large-scale variational Monte-Carlo calculations using neural-network quantum states (NQSs) with kagome-geometry-aware message-passing convolution on two-dimensional tori containing up to 300 spins, and achieve exceptionally low variational energies for the kagome model. The spin and dimer structure factors show no evidence of magnetic or valence-bond long-range order. Moreover, the dominant symmetry-resolved spin and dimer correlations exhibit a common scaling behavior consistent with the emergent SO(6) monopole multiplet of the Dirac spin liquid. Finally, the fidelity of the optimized NQSs with Gutzwiller-projected mean-field states increasingly favors the Dirac state over the competing Z₂ candidates as the system size grows. Together, these complementary results provide evidence for a U(1) Dirac spin-liquid ground state in the kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet.

title: Benchmarking and advancing machine-learning interatomic potentials for 3C-SiC across equilibrium and extreme conditions
title_zh: 在平衡和极端条件下对3C-SiC的机器学习原子间电位进行基准测试和推进
summary: 已经针对立方碳化硅 (3C-SiC) 开发了几种机器学习原子间势 (MLIP)。在这里，我们针对一组常见的结构、热、缺陷、辐射损伤、无序相和计算性能测试对七个现有的 MLIP 进行了基准测试。我们还引入了两种互补的 MLIP，它们经过 DFT 标记的晶体、液体、无定形和缺陷配置的训练。 TGAP，基于动词 |soap_turbo| 的高斯近似势描述符，在采样的配置空间中提供一致的高精度。
abstract: arXiv:2510.06966v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Several machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have been developed for cubic silicon carbide (3C-SiC). Here, we benchmark seven existing MLIPs against a common set of structural, thermal, defect, radiation-damage, disordered-phase, and computational-performance tests. We also introduce two complementary MLIPs trained on DFT-labeled crystalline, liquid, amorphous, and defective configurations. TGAP, a Gaussian approximation potential based on the verb|soap_turbo| descriptor, provides consistently high accuracy across the sampled configurational space. MTP, a custom moment tensor potential, retains good accuracy across these regimes while offering substantially lower computational cost, GPU acceleration, and access to multi-million-atom simulations. As an application-level test, both potentials remain stable in displacement cascades spanning short-range repulsion, transient disorder, and recrystallization. Overall, MTP emerges as a particularly strong accuracy--cost compromise for large-scale and strongly non-equilibrium simulations of 3C-SiC.

title: Small-data physics-informed ML model for magnetic exchange based on chemical composition and structure
title_zh: 基于化学成分和结构的磁交换小数据物理信息机器学习模型
summary: 在本文中，我们提出了一种基于密集神经网络群的集成模型，能够以小于 1% 的误差预测海森堡交换相互作用。该模型使用从头算薛定谔方程的输入，即化合物结构和化学成分。在第一项工作中，我们对六方锰酸盐家族的几种化合物训练了模型，并能够以类似的精度推断出随机选择几何形状的同一家族其他化合物的 J 值，从而表明我们准确地了解了化学成分和结构对有效磁积分 J 的影响。
abstract: arXiv:2611.04681v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this paper we propose an ensemble model based on a swarm of dense neural networks, able to predict Heisenberg exchange interactions within less than 1% error. The model uses the inputs of the ab-initio Schrödinger equation, i.e. the compound structure and chemical composition. In this first work, we trained the model on a few compounds of the hexagonal manganite family and were able to infer, with similar accuracy, the J values for other compounds of the same family at randomly chosen geometries, thus showing that we accurately learned the effect of the chemical composition and structure on effective magnetic integrals J.

title: A local orchestration harness for molecular design with foundation models
title_zh: 用于具有基础模型的分子设计的本地编排工具
summary: 分子设计需要协调生成、性质预测和迭代编辑，每个决定都与正确的化学结构和支持证据相关。在实践中整合这些功能提出了三个主要挑战：保留分子数据的本地控制、跨任务连接专门模型以及验证所提出的更改是否满足化学约束。在这里，我们介绍了 MolCrew，这是一个可本地部署的系统，它通过语言模型协调器和 RDKit 计算来协调四名单独训练的分子专家。专家根据描述生成结构，描述分子结构，预测生物终点并针对特定目标提出编辑建议。单独的模型权重允许在工作流程中独立评估和更新每个功能。
abstract: arXiv:2611.03676v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Molecular design requires coordinated generation, property prediction and iterative editing, with each decision linked to the correct chemical structure and supporting evidence. Integrating these capabilities in practice presents three major challenges: retaining local control of molecular data, connecting specialized models across tasks and verifying that proposed changes satisfy chemical constraints. Here we present MolCrew, a locally deployable system that coordinates four separately trained molecular specialists with a language-model orchestrator and RDKit calculations. The specialists generate structures from descriptions, describe molecular structures, predict biological endpoints and propose edits towards specified goals. Separate model weights allow each capability to be evaluated and updated independently within the workflow. RDKit calculations check structural validity, quantify descriptor changes and assess specified structural constraints, while returned observations guide further tool calls. We evaluated low-rank adaptation of the orchestrator for tool-use decisions and failure recovery while leaving specialist weights unchanged. On 3,300 ChEBI-20 test examples, MolCrew achieved 96.4% exact structure recovery, compared with 38.7% for published Atomas-large results. Across eight MoleculeNet datasets evaluated using scaffold splits, mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve was 0.851, compared with 0.770 for published Atomas results. In a recorded evaluation using the unadapted orchestrator, 1,554 of 1,699 requests (91.5%) passed every predefined workflow check. By preserving inspectable links between molecular proposals, model outputs and chemical calculations, MolCrew provides a modular framework for computational candidate assessment and refinement under local data control.

title: When do machine-learning potentials need a configuration-dependent kernel? Learning long-range interactions with Fourier neural operators
title_zh: 机器学习潜力何时需要依赖于配置的内核？学习与傅立叶神经算子的远程交互
summary: 机器学习原子间势中的长程相互作用通常通过通过规定的静电核或学习但与配置无关的核耦合学习源来处理。这样的内核是否足够取决于底层的屏蔽交互。我们通过使用傅里叶神经算子 (FNO) 来解决这个问题，以了解根据本地骨干网（此处为 MACE）的描述符构建的潜在源场如何在模拟单元中相互作用。对于具有可调谐屏蔽的合成离子系统，规定的库仑核在强屏蔽下将长波长电荷波动低估了 43%，而 FNO 在 3% 内再现了它们，并恢复了本地主干留下的残差方差的 95-99%。
abstract: arXiv:2611.03678v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-range interactions in machine-learning interatomic potentials are commonly treated by coupling learned sources through either a prescribed electrostatic kernel or a learned but configuration-independent one. Whether such a kernel suffices depends on the underlying screened interaction. We address this question by using Fourier neural operators (FNOs) to learn how latent source fields, built from the descriptors of a local backbone (here MACE), interact across the simulation cell. For a synthetic ionic system with tunable screening, a prescribed Coulomb kernel underestimates the long-wavelength charge fluctuations by 43% under strong screening, whereas the FNO reproduces them within 3% and recovers 95-99% of the variance of the residual left by the local backbone. A linear FNO, which learns a configuration-independent kernel, performs equally well in the homogeneous case. Under inhomogeneous screening, rearranging the remote medium modulates the coupling between distant ions, a dependence that no configuration-independent kernel can represent. Among the models tested, only the nonlinear FNO responds to this modulation, and its force errors are 27-41% lower than those of configuration-independent models. In first-principles benchmarks of liquid water, lithium lanthanum zirconate, and Au2/MgO(001), MACE-FNO is comparable to a prescribed-kernel model for the bulk systems and more accurate for the interface. It further captures the reversal of the Au2 wetting preference induced by remote Al dopants, with deviations below 5 meV per cell from density functional theory. These results indicate that a configuration-dependent kernel, as learned by FNOs, becomes necessary once the screening medium varies, even though the energy remains quadratic in the charges for a fixed medium.

title: Isothermal-Isobaric Molecular Dynamics with a Foundation Interatomic Potential in LAMMPS across NVIDIA and Intel GPUs
title_zh: 跨 NVIDIA 和 Intel GPU 的 LAMMPS 中具有基础原子间势的等温-等压分子动力学
summary: 基础机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 为许多化学提供了一种模型，但它们的深层全局耦合架构不适合缩放经典和短程 MLIP 的空间分解。我们提出了pair_style uma，这是一种 LAMMPS 对样式，可通过 NVIDIA 和 Intel GPU 上的 LibTorch 从单一源树评估通用原子模型 (UMA)。
abstract: arXiv:2611.03892v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Foundation machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) offer one model for many chemistries, but their deep, globally coupled architectures do not fit the spatial decomposition that scales classical and short-ranged MLIPs. We present pair_style uma, a LAMMPS pair style that evaluates the Universal Model for Atoms (UMA) through LibTorch on NVIDIA and Intel GPUs from a single source tree. It reimplements FairChem's edge-sharded graph parallelism in C++ over exported TorchScript modules, with one MPI rank per device, NCCL or oneCCL collectives, and the whole energy and force path in double precision. The strain-gradient virial is carried through the exported modules and the cross-device reductions, so that fix npt runs on both vendors' hardware. We measure NPT capacity and cost on one 4xA100-40GB node, one 8xH200 node, and one 12-tile Intel node, and on up to 32 Intel nodes. Without activation checkpointing, one node holds NaCl cells of about 8,000 atoms (A100, 0.21 ns/day), 22,000 atoms (Intel, 0.10 ns/day), and 47,000 atoms (H200, 0.16 ns/day). Graph parallelism raises the capacity of a single device by 8.0x on H200 and 4.6x on A100. Across nodes, capacity grows to about 779,000 atoms on 32 Intel nodes, with a slower speed at 0.007 ns/day. On H200 and A100, a FLOP count of FairChem's graph-parallel predictor gives lower bounds of 31% and 51% of FP64 peak. From one omat checkpoint and with no refit, nine 100 ps NPT heating ramps (NaCl, equiatomic Pt-Ru, and equiatomic (HfNbTaTiZr)N, on all three node types) ran to completion.

title: LaQX: A JAX Toolkit for Neural Quantum State Simulations of Lattice Quantum Many-Body Models
title_zh: LaQX：用于晶格量子多体模型神经量子态模拟的 JAX 工具包
summary: 神经量子态为相互作用的晶格费米子和自旋提供了准确的变分表示。然而，将新的 ansatz 转变为可重复的计算，需要哈密顿量、采样、优化、可观测值和加速器并行性的协调实现。我们提出了 LaQX（基于 jaX 的晶格量子模拟），这是一个基于 JAX 的开源神经量子状态库，它通过通用功能接口组织这些组件。除了基态变分蒙特卡罗之外，LaQX 还支持激发态计算、格林函数蒙特卡罗细化、绝热演化以及依赖时间的变分蒙特卡罗的实时演化。
abstract: arXiv:2611.04333v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural quantum states provide accurate variational representations for interacting lattice fermions and spins. Turning a new ansatz into a reproducible calculation, however, requires coordinated implementations of the Hamiltonian, sampling, optimization, observables, and accelerator parallelism. We present LaQX (Lattice Quantum simulation based on jaX), an open-source neural quantum state library based on JAX that organizes these components through common functional interfaces. Beyond ground-state variational Monte Carlo, LaQX supports excited-state calculations, Green's Function Monte Carlo refinement, adiabatic evolution, and real-time evolution with time-dependent variational Monte Carlo. It consolidates methods developed in recent high-accuracy neural quantum state studies of the Hubbard model and frustrated magnets, and the package has been used to investigate the triangular-lattice Hofstadter-Hubbard model. We document these capabilities with reproducible calculations for Hubbard, J₁-J₂ Heisenberg, altermagnetic Hubbard, and interacting Hofstadter models. Function-oriented modules separate the scientific components and limit the source context needed for extensions by human developers and large language models. Source code, documentation, and executable examples are available at https://github.com/bytedance/laqx.

title: From 4D to 2D: Efficient computation of the electron correlation energies of atoms in molecular systems
title_zh: 从 4D 到 2D：有效计算分子系统中原子的电子相关能
summary: （生物）分子系统的精确建模仍然是计算化学中的主要挑战。近年来，机器学习势（MLP）已成为一种有前途的方法，它将经典力场的效率与接近量子力学的精度结合起来。其中，基于物理的 MLP FFLUX 采用相互作用量子原子 (IQA) 能量分配方案，将分子能量分解为源自量子力学的原子贡献，用于机器学习。然而，由于与两粒子密度矩阵 (2PDM) 的必要存储和评估相关的陡峭计算缩放，目前将二电子相关能纳入 IQA 并最终纳入 FFLUX 对于大型系统来说是不可行的。
abstract: The accurate modeling of (bio)molecular systems remains a major challenge in computational chemistry. In recent years, machine learning potentials (MLPs) have emerged as a promising approach, combining the efficiency of classical force fields with near quantum-mechanical accuracy. Among these, the physics-informed MLP FFLUX employs the Interacting Quantum Atoms (IQA) energy partitioning scheme to decompose molecular energies into atomic contributions derived from quantum mechanics for machine learning. However, incorporating two-electron correlation energies into IQA, and consequently into FFLUX, is currently unfeasible for larger systems en masse , due to the steep computational scaling associated with the necessary storage and evaluation of the two-particle density matrix (2PDM). In this work, we introduce a proof-of-concept workflow that employs density fitting (DF) to compress the 2PDM into a two-index representation, thereby accelerating the IQA partitioning of two-electron correlation energies. By expressing traditionally four-center electron repulsion integrals in terms of auxiliary basis functions, the DF approximation enables a size reduction of the 2PDM from O(N4) to O(NDF2), where N is the number of basis functions and N DF is the size of the auxiliary basis set. The method proposed here is demonstrated using coupled cluster singles and doubles densities. The resulting reduction in computational cost and memory requirements enables correlated IQA analyses for significantly larger systems than previously accessible. Thus, this development provides an important step toward incorporating explicit electron correlation and hence dispersion directly into FFLUX atomic ML models, thereby improving both their physical robustness and transferability. This advance will eliminate the need to artificially add empirical potentials, or a posteriori dispersion correction.
journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

title: Toward Intelligent Thermal Fluids: AI-Driven Design of Zeta-Engineered Nanofluids and Self-Organized Thermal Transport Networks
title_zh: 迈向智能热流体：人工智能驱动的 Zeta 工程纳米流体设计和自组织热传输网络
summary: 下一代纳米流体的开发需要从经验配方方法转向数据驱动的设计策略，同时优化导热性、动态粘度、稳定性和系统级性能。这一观点强调了人工智能 (AI)、zeta 电位 (ZP) 工程和先进纳米材料在智能热流体设计中的新兴融合。特别强调的是 ZP 工程纳米流体，其中静电相互作用经过精心定制，以控制纳米粒子的分散、稳定性和自组织热传输网络的形成。虽然互连的纳米粒子网络可以增强热传输，但过度的网络连接性，特别是在碳纳米管和石墨烯衍生物等高纵横比纳米材料中，可能会增加动态粘度和液压阻力。
abstract: The development of next-generation nanofluids requires a shift from empirical formulation approaches toward data-driven design strategies that simultaneously optimize thermal conductivity, dynamic viscosity, stability, and system-level performance. This perspective highlights the emerging convergence of artificial intelligence (AI), zeta-potential (ZP) engineering, and advanced nanomaterials for the design of intelligent thermal fluids. Particular emphasis is placed on ZP-engineered nanofluids, in which electrostatic interactions are deliberately tailored to control nanoparticle dispersion, stability, and the formation of self-organized thermal transport networks. While interconnected nanoparticle networks can enhance thermal transport, excessive network connectivity, especially in high-aspect-ratio nanomaterials such as carbon nanotubes and graphene derivatives, may increase the dynamic viscosity and hydraulic resistance. Therefore, optimal nanofluid design requires balancing competing thermophysical and operational objectives under application-specific conditions. An AI-driven framework integrating machine learning, physics-informed machine learning, explainable AI, active learning, and multi-objective optimization is presented to accelerate nanofluid discovery and optimization. A representative case study of ZP-engineered iron oxide-carbon nanotube-graphene oxide nanofluids demonstrates the use of data-driven modeling, feature-importance analysis, SHAP interpretation, and Pareto optimization. The integration of AI-guided optimization with ZP-controlled network engineering provides a promising pathway toward intelligent thermal fluids and autonomous materials discovery for advanced thermal management systems.

title: Defect-free model of amorphous silicon with pristine electronic structure
title_zh: 具有原始电子结构的非晶硅无缺陷模型

title: NovoCRF: Globally Normalized De Novo Peptide Sequencing on a Prefix-Mass Lattice
title_zh: NovoCRF：前缀质量点阵上的全局标准化从头肽测序
summary: 从头肽测序已经从手工设计或生成分数的动态编程转变为端到端学习任务的大型变压器。我们提出了 NovoCRF，一种条件随机场 (CRF)，其状态是前缀质量，因此其路径恰好是前体质量 +/-0.06 Da 内的肽。一个小型网络根据物理衍生的离子匹配特征对每个边缘进行评分，并使用其在所有质量可行的肽上全局归一化的分数进行训练。据我们所知，NovoCRF 是第一个对所有质量可行的肽进行精确归一化训练的从头方法。
abstract: arXiv:2611.05260v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: De novo peptide sequencing has moved from dynamic programming over hand-designed or generative scores to large transformers that learn the task end to end. We present NovoCRF, a conditional random field (CRF) whose states are prefix masses, so that its paths are exactly the peptides within +/-0.06 Da of the precursor mass. A small network scores each edge from physics-derived ion-match features and is trained with its scores globally normalized over all mass-feasible peptides. To our knowledge, NovoCRF is the first de novo method trained with exact normalization over all mass-feasible peptides. Our software has three modules, each with exactly one job: a precursor mass finder recovers the accurate precursor mass from MS1, the CRF finds the peptides that fit the precursor mass by exact k-best decoding, and two BiGRU rerankers add sequence context and internal-fragment evidence. The model has 310k parameters and trains in about 17 GPU-hours. On seven held-out data-dependent acquisition datasets published in 2026 (126,262 labeled spectra), NovoCRF's mean peptide recall is 42.4%, against 39.1% for Casanovo v5 with five beams, and its amino-acid recall 64.0% against 53.1%, at 1,746 spectra/s on 18 CPU threads, 55x Casanovo's throughput on a GPU. Split by fragment evidence, NovoCRF leads on labels with up to three peptide bonds without a b or y ion, and Casanovo only beyond. NovoCRF can also search modifications it was never trained on at their exact mass: it finds 32.1% of the hydroxyproline peptides of a lion bone sample.

title: Vortices in a two-dimensional fermionic superfluid
title_zh: 二维费米子超流体中的涡旋
summary: 量子化涡旋是超流性的标志。事实证明，它们是从超流氦到 II 型超导体等系统中不可或缺的探测器。在超冷二维 (2D) 费米气体中，相涨落增强，Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT) 机制控制超流体转变，但他们的观察仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们报告了 BEC-BCS 交叉中均匀二维气体中量子化涡流的受控创建。通过连续调整两个移动障碍物的速度，我们观察到绝对涡流电荷的量化步骤。物质波干涉测量揭示了以 2π 为单位量化的特征相绕组。
abstract: arXiv:2611.05017v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantized vortices are a hallmark of superfluidity. They have proven to be an indispensable probe for systems ranging from superfluid helium to type-II superconductors. In ultracold two-dimensional (2D) Fermi gases, where phase fluctuations are enhanced and the Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT) mechanism governs the superfluid transition, their observation has remained elusive. Here, we report on the controlled creation of quantized vortices in a homogeneous 2D gas in the BEC--BCS crossover. By continuously tuning the velocity of two moving obstacles, we observe quantized steps in the absolute vortex charge. Matter-wave interferometry reveals the characteristic phase winding, quantized in units of 2π. Measurements on 2D and 3D gases show a striking difference: only in 2D does the vortex number grow with temperature, reflecting thermal activation of BKT vortex pairs. Our approach provides evidence of fermionic superfluidity in 2D and offers a means to study BKT physics, vortex-controlled transport and resistance, as well as to detect unconventional superfluidity in spin-imbalanced 2D gases.

title: Altermagnetism-induced Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov superfluids and momentum-selective pairing channels in optical lattices
title_zh: 交变磁力诱导的 Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov 超流体和光学晶格中的动量选择性配对通道
summary: 我们研究了光学晶格中二维简并费米气体的超流体相，该气体受到与面内自旋分量耦合的 dₓy 波交磁项的影响。单粒子哈密顿量为两个赝自旋物种生成各向异性费米表面，同时保持零净极化。
abstract: arXiv:2611.04214v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the superfluid phases of a two-dimensional degenerate Fermi gas in an optical lattice subject to a dₓy-wave altermagnetic term that couples to the in-plane spin component. The single-particle Hamiltonian generates anisotropic Fermi surfaces for the two pseudo-spin species while maintaining zero net polarization. Using the Bogoliubov-de Gennes approach, we show that this anisotropy favors Cooper pairing at a finite center-of-mass momentum, producing a competition between Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) and Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov (FFLO) pairing and leading to FFLO superfluids. We further examine the effect of a Zeeman-induced spin polarization and find that triplet and singlet pairing channels coexist and compete, resulting in a momentum-selective pairing pattern. Remarkably, this triplet pairing emerges exclusively in the FFLO phase and is entirely absent in the BCS phase. The model is readily realizable in ultracold atoms with current experimental techniques, providing a feasible route for quantum emulation and for studying unconventional superfluid phases.

title: Loss of altermagnetic order and smooth restoration of Kramers' spin degeneracy with increasing temperature in CrSb and MnTe
title_zh: CrSb和MnTe中随温度升高而变化的磁序的丧失和Kramers自旋退化的平稳恢复
summary: 我们描述了热诱导的自旋波动如何通过应用无序局部矩图来改变两个典型替代磁体CrSb和MnTe的电子结构。对于这两种材料，我们自洽的从头计算表明， Cr和Mn原子在顺磁状态下存在局部磁矩，需要对电子结构进行自旋极化描述，甚至高于Néel温度T_N。此外，克莱默斯的自旋退化（ Kramers 'spin degeneracy ）在两种材料的变磁基态下都被打破，平均而言，随着局部时刻的热紊乱，克莱默斯的自旋退化被平稳地恢复。
abstract: arXiv:2603.15035v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We describe how thermally induced spin fluctuations modify the electronic structures of two prototypical altermagnets, CrSb and MnTe, via application of the disordered local moment picture. For both materials, our self-consistent, ab initio calculations demonstrate that local magnetic moments persist on Cr and Mn atoms in their paramagnetic states, necessitating a spin-polarised description of the electronic structure even above the Néel temperature, T_N. Moreover, Kramers' spin degeneracy, which is broken for both materials in their altermagnetic ground states, is shown to be smoothly restored - on the average - as the local moments thermally disorder. In metallic CrSb, this occurs at temperatures well below T_N and the signature effects of its altermagnetism are lost as the magnetic disorder induces heavy smearing of strongly dispersive electronic states around the Fermi energy. By contrast, in semiconducting MnTe, with its band gap largely unaffected by magnetic disorder, the spin degeneracy only returns at temperatures close to and above T_N. We quantify the temperature dependence of the altermagnetic order parameter and the underlying electronic structures of both materials, with implications for their spin transport and spectroscopic properties.

title: Chiral Phonons Coupled to Spin-Split Bands in Altermagnetic CrSb and MnTe
title_zh: 手性声子耦合到Altermagnetic CrSb和MnTe中的自旋分裂带
summary: Altermagnet表现出动量依赖的自旋分裂，没有净磁化，提供了一个独特的平台，磁序、电子结构和晶格动力学交织在一起。在这里，使用第一原理计算，我们证明了原型改变磁体CrSb和MnTe在动量空间中承载有限声子角动量的局部手性声子模，具有六瓣f波纹理。
abstract: arXiv:2607.04802v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Altermagnets exhibit momentum-dependent spin splitting without net magnetization, providing a unique platform where magnetic order, electronic structure and lattice dynamics intertwine. Here, using first-principles calculations, we demonstrate that the prototypical altermagnets CrSb and MnTe host locally chiral phonon modes carrying finite phonon angular momentum with a six-lobes f-wave texture in momentum space. Our results show that the chiral lattice motion originates from the pnictogen/chalcogen sublattice, while the altermagnetic spin splitting is generated by the magnetic transition-metal atoms, indicating that chiral lattice dynamics and altermagnetic electronic states originate from different atomic sublattices of the same crystal. In pristine compounds, at each valley, inversion symmetry suppresses the net phonon angular momentum despite local circular atomic motion. We further demonstrate that isoelectronic symmetry lowering induced by chemical substitution lifts this cancellation and generates finite valley phonon chirality, while keeping the altermagnetic nature of the compounds intact. Most importantly, we reveal that chiral phonons couple to momentum-dependent spin-split electronic bands through momentum-dependent electron-phonon interaction, producing characteristic modifications of the electronic structure, possibly accessible by photoemission experiments. Our results establish altermagnets as a promising platform for chiral phononics and spin-selective lattice control.

title: An Atlas of Classical Pyrochlore Spin Liquids
title_zh: 经典烧绿石旋转液体图集
summary: 烧绿石晶格磁体中的受挫磁性已被证明是自旋液体的实验和理论研究中最富有成果的环境。除了自旋冰的典型情况之外，最近的工作还发现了由该晶格的通用最近邻各向异性自旋哈密顿量产生的各种新的经典和量子自旋液体。然而，一直缺乏对这些奇异物质状态进行彻底、系统分类和表征的通用框架，以及该模型可以支持的所有可能的自旋液体的详尽列表，也许最有趣的是，它们的新兴场论描述的相应结构是什么。
abstract: arXiv:2411.03547v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Frustrated magnetism in the pyrochlore lattice magnet has proven to be a most fruitful setting for the experimental and theoretical search for spin liquids. Besides the canonical case of spin ice, recent works have identified a variety of new classical and quantum spin liquids engendered by the generic nearest-neighbor anisotropic spin Hamiltonian for that lattice. However, a general framework for the thorough and systematic classification and characterization of these exotic states of matter has been lacking, as has an exhaustive list of all possible spin liquids that this model can support and, perhaps most interesting, what is the corresponding structure of their emergent field theory description. In this work, we develop such a theoretical framework to identify the interaction parameters stabilizing different classical spin liquids and derive their corresponding effective generalized Gauss's laws at low temperatures. Combining this with Monte Carlo simulations, we systematically identify all classical spin liquids for the general nearest-neighbor anisotropic spin Hamiltonian on the pyrochlore lattice. In doing so, we uncover new spin liquid models with exotic forms of generalized Gauss's law and multipole conservation laws. Our approach allows us to compile an atlas of all spin liquids realized in the phase diagram, providing a global picture of their mutual connections in parameter space and transitions between them. Our work will inform future theoretical and experimental studies of classical and quantum spin liquids on the pyrochlore lattice and help rationalize the exotic properties of pyrochlore magnets.
